payload.title: Add tasks fleet rebase for dirty PRs
payload.body:
Add a fleet rebase command next to fleet auto-merge in packages/cli/src/commands/fleet.ts. It rebases PRs that report merge conflicts or a behind state, then force-pushes with lease. Source idea: https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/auto-rebase-dirty-prs.mjs (credit only).
- **Hypothesis**: a one-command rebase of dirty fleet PRs cuts the median time a dirty PR waits for a human from hours to under 10 minutes.
- **Measurement**: npm test -w packages/cli -- fleet-rebase (fake gh, 3 dirty PRs)
- **Success**: 3 of 3 dirty fixture PRs rebase cleanly; a conflicting PR is skipped and reported, never force-pushed.
- **Pivot**: if the skipped-conflict rate is above 50% on real fleets, drop the command and keep only a report.
- **Anchor**: Forsgren, Humble, Kim 2018 (lead time for changes).
